notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least four artifacts and/or enchantments.
description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Dockside Extortionist.
Ashnod the Uncaring triggers, copying Viscera Seer's ability.
Resolve both Viscera Seer abilities, causing you to scry 1 twice.
Activate Bonecaller Cleric by paying {3}{B} and sacrificing it, targeting Dockside Extortionist.
Ashnod the Uncaring triggers, copying Bonecaller Cleric's ability, with the copy targeting Bonecaller Cleric.
Resolve both Bonecaller Cleric abilities, returning it and Dockside Extortionist to the battlefield from your graveyard.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least three Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}.
Repeat.
If opponents control four or more artifacts and/or enchantments, this combo nets infinite Treasure tokens.
